name: Team Charmander: Inferno Descent Legion
archetype: Route travel configuration — Electric/Psychic speed sweeping, Ice fortress coverage, Fighting wallbreaking, and Intimidate physical pivot. No gym duel this chapter.
gym_duel_rationale: No gym battle this chapter. Gym duel core retained from Chapter 16 (Clair's 5v5 Rising Badge duel). All six party members train freely across Route 46 and New Bark Town, elevated to Cap 72 in route-travel configuration.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST hybrid anchor elevated to Cap 72. Sleep Powder neutralizes the static Slaking before it can act. STAB Flamethrower and Air Slash provide broad offensive coverage.
500 BST speed demon with 120 SpA. Thunderbolt dispatches Fearow and Gligar. Psychic hits Route 46's Fighting-weak targets.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 71. Hydro Pump devastates Route 46's Graveler and Donphan. Ice Beam handles Gligar.
477 BST physical wallbreaker. Earthquake and Close Combat deliver brutal super-effective damage to Route 46's Graveler. Vital Spirit prevents Sleep from wild Wigglytuff's Sing.
522 BST Intimidate pivot. Cuts physical Attack on entry. Earth Power handles Graveler. Megahorn provides Bug coverage against Wigglytuff.
Colossal 160 HP tank. No gym duel restriction this chapter — full 6-member route travel. RestTalk loop provides infinite sustain.

flex_bench.rationale: High-Speed Flying pivot providing Tailwind speed doubling and Roost recovery.
Levitate Ground immunity and high physical Defense with Sludge Bomb against Route 46's Ground swarm.
Iron Fist-boosted Thunder Punch and Ice Punch for versatile tech coverage against diverse wild encounters.
